readout_other: finger tapping score (Quiq 2.0 tablet app); TMS-evoked MEP latency and amplitude of right abductor pollicis brevis; VAS discomfort
direction_notes: After real TUS the tapping score and MEP amplitude were higher and MEP latency shorter than after sham, indicating increased motor cortex excitability.
safety_notes: One participant experienced mild dizziness after TUS that disappeared within 5 min; VAS discomfort did not differ between real and sham.
